projects.title: Rezang La War Memorial
projects.subtitle: Collateral designing | Content production
projects.description: Coffee table book designs, editorial layouts, commemorative publication architecture, and visual content production for the Rezang La War Memorial honoring the supreme sacrifice of the 114 gallant soldiers in the 1962 Battle of Rezang La.
projects.scopeOfWork: Complete coffee table book design, editorial architecture, hardbound cover systems, archival typography, photo restoration, and on-location memorial documentation.
projects.creativeApproach: Subtle, dignified layout allowing historical accounts, family tributes, and veteran testimonies to stand out with gravitas.
projects.productionDiscipline: High-specification tactile print finishing, custom clothbound styling, and archival reproduction.
